how: Australian Poker League events run weekly at Sydney clubs such as Bankstown Sports Club, and The Star Sydney poker room runs weekly Monday and Wednesday tournaments.
Gentleman Magician Bruce Glen runs a weekly parlour magic show at Sir Stamford Circular Quay, and Magic in Sydney lists regular close-up shows and lectures; no open hands-on club confirmed.
venue: The Gentleman Magician's Magical Soiree (Sir Stamford Circular Quay)

how: Battlecry: Age of Markoth is a weekly Friday-night boffer LARP in Rooty Hill, Western Sydney, using latex-covered fibreglass weapons; Time Out profiles Sydney's LARP scene.
Kitepower teaches kitesurfing lessons in Botany Bay (Dolls Point, Monterey, Sans Souci) and KBL Sports also runs kiteboarding lessons there.
Nordic Edge runs one-day introductory blacksmithing workshops (about six hours, max six students) in Brookvale where participants forge a bottle opener and small items.
Outer Heaven Drone Racing in Western Sydney runs MultiGP race rounds, including a May 2026 regional qualifier with 14 pilots.
NSW Rocketry Association (a Tripoli prefecture) holds supervised, insured launch days for low-power rockets, with club launch gear available to members.
Sakeshop runs the half-day Sake Explorer class in Stanmore (next 17 October 2026) for fans and beginners, and other Sydney venues hold sake masterclasses.
Beginner hands-on cheese-making classes (halloumi, burrata, bocconcini) run in Sydney, e.g. Omnom Cheese at Rosebery, plus a full-day intensive course in Canterbury.
Sorella Cacao runs a three-hour bean-to-bar chocolate making workshop (make a 50g bar) via Wollemi Ridge Retreats; the listed session has passed and the venue location is unconfirmed.
Maimai Glass in Brookvale and a Marrickville glass artist run 2.5-hour beginner flameworking bead-making workshops.
Harp Centre Australia lists Sydney harp teachers (Rowan Phemister, Owen Torr, Maryanne Tucker) and Northern Beaches Community College has run a Learn the Harp beginner course.
North Ryde RSL Pipe Band rehearses weekly on Thursday evenings at Epping Creative Centre and teaches beginners with instruments and uniforms supplied.
A Sydney sitar teacher (SITARBYRAVI) offers one-off beginner workshops and private lessons and performs at Sydney Fringe; no school or ensemble confirmed.
WEA Sydney runs a Learn to Debate course that leads into the WEA Debate Club, held face to face at 72 Bathurst Street.
Woollahra Sailing Club at Rose Bay lists windsurfing under its Sailing School, and forums report beginner windsurfing at Rose Bay, Botany Bay (Kyeemagh) and Iron Cove.
Geocaching NSW runs regular community events and meets, including the Sydney GeoQuest Block Party at Sydney Olympic Park in January 2025; caches are free to seek with a phone app.
The Australian Railway Historical Society (NSW Division) is a Sydney society of railway enthusiasts with a resource centre, magazines and rail tours and excursions; train spotting itself is informal.
The Horological Society of New York is teaching a traveling four-hour watch movement disassembly course in Sydney (21-22 November 2026), and TAFE NSW lists a watch and clock repair course.
venue: HSNY traveling course / TAFE NSW watch and clock repair

how: Beginner macrame workshops (wall hangings, plant hangers) run in Sydney, e.g. Melissa's Art Studio in Marrickville and PidegoArt in Dulwich Hill, and via ClassBento.
Tom Bass Sculpture Studio School in Erskineville runs multi-week stone carving courses (limestone, marble, alabaster), and a one-day soft stone sculpture workshop is listed on ClassBento.
Sydney troupes such as JWK Dragon and Lion Dance Association, Chinese Youth League Lion and Dragon Dance Australia and Guangzhou Pak Mei school perform at Lunar New Year and train year-round.
venue: JWK Dragon and Lion Dance Association

how: Open Academy at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music lists guzheng courses with tutor Vicki Zheng for all ages and levels, and Sydney Guyun Guzheng Arts Academy also teaches.
venue: Open Academy, Sydney Conservatorium of Music
